messages:
maya: planning a controlled unpin of runtime 2.14 -> 3.0 for a small canary tonight 22:00 PT. noticed kv-cache warmup latency on quant models in ap-south. propose region-scoped model pin + SDK caller lock. any objections?

leo: which quant models? severity?

maya: quant-v4b-longseq and a trimmed llama3 variant; p95 spikes during first 200 requests, occasional transient 502s.

august: prefer model-variant pin in ap-south for 18h rather than global runtime pin. reduces blast radius.

maya: agreed. also ask devx/docs to publish brief notice and advise customers to use SDK 1.7.x for the canary cohort.

docs: drafting note now, will post in #release-notes and update status page.

maya: deploybot, apply model pin in ap-south TTL=18h initiator=maya

deploybot: Executing: /deploy pin model quant-v4b-longseq-stable --region ap-south --ttl 18h --initiator=maya
deploybot: Done. pin-id=pin-1765439999-aps. Affected endpoints: /generate.

leo: starting a 10% traffic ramp for 20m, then checkpoints at 30/60/100 if healthy. auto-abort if p95 > baseline*1.4 or 5xx +0.5%.

august: runbook: if issue persists after model pin and ramp -> soft rollback runtime in ap-south to 2.14 for canary cohort only. i'll own the rollback. rollback command staged in runbook.

maya: checklist before rollback: 1) confirm kvcache warmed logs 2) capture heap + jstack 3) tag traces with canary:1765439999 4) notify enterprise-svcs if any contracts impacted.

eng-ops: heap and traces uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/1765439999/; monitoring dashboards live.

leo: 10% ramp in progress. p95 +18% but under abort threshold. no OOMs.

august: holding rollback. if checkpoint fails execute: /deploy rollback runtime 3.0 --region ap-south --cohort canary --reason "kv warmup regression"

docs: advisory posted. short line in release notes: "Ap-south canary: pinned quant-v4b-longseq to stable variant; SDK 1.7.x recommended for canary callers."

maya: scheduling automated unpin at 1765516400 (unpin-id=unpin-1765439999-aps). leave thread for one-liners: GO/HOLD/ROLLBACK. will close after unpin or rollback.

leo: GO at +25m; moving to 30% checkpoint.

august: noted. all set.
